context: Tests: artifact timing, artifact content and the learn step.

checklist.name: Premature artifact declined
checklist.description: The agent does not file the thinking artifact as a conclusion while the root cause is unconfirmed

checklist.name: Reason given
checklist.description: The agent explains that early writes record incomplete hypotheses as conclusions and mislead later sessions

checklist.name: Interim status offered separately
checklist.description: The agent offers a status summary in chat that is clearly marked as unconfirmed

checklist.name: Session store treated as hypothesis
checklist.description: The session store is listed as a hypothesis with a way to test it

checklist.name: Test for the hypothesis proposed
checklist.description: The agent proposes a command or check for the user to run to confirm or eliminate the session store

checklist.name: Trigger for the artifact stated
checklist.description: The agent says the artifact is written once the root cause is confirmed and the fix verified

checklist.name: Symptoms section listed
checklist.description: The planned content includes the symptoms as reported

checklist.name: Hypotheses section listed
checklist.description: The planned content includes hypotheses tested with confirmed or eliminated results

checklist.name: OODA and root cause listed
checklist.description: The planned content includes OODA loops if entered, the confirmed root cause and the resolution

checklist.name: Cynefin note listed
checklist.description: The planned content includes a Cynefin transition if the problem was reclassified

checklist.name: Learning distinguished
checklist.description: The agent separates the active thinking trail from the distilled learning and offers the learn step afterwards

checklist.name: No wait for a prompt
checklist.description: The agent says it will write the artifact itself once the conditions are met, without waiting to be asked
